description: Na₃PO₄ is Enargite structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmn2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with eight NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.28 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with eight equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.36 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with twelve NaO₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.54 Å) and three longer (1.55 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal pyramidal geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom.
